niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" connected TV (CTV) advertising agency, as the top choice depends on your budget, whether you need self-serve software or a full-service agency, and your specific campaign goals.
Industry reports and rankings highlight several top-performing platforms and agencies specializing in CTV and convergent TV advertising:
Tatari: Known as a convergent TV advertising platform that lets brands plan, buy, optimize, and measure campaigns across both CTV and traditional linear TV from a single interface.
The Trade Desk: A leading independent demand-side platform (DSP) offering powerful programmatic tools, audience data, and cross-channel CTV reach.
Amazon DSP: Lets advertisers target audiences across Prime Video, Twitch, Fire TV Channels, and major third-party streaming apps using Amazon's first-party shopper data.
StackAdapt: A popular self-serve programmatic advertising platform featuring AI-driven optimization and multi-channel campaign management including CTV.
MNTN: Focuses heavily on performance CTV, tying streaming video ads directly to website visits and revenue tracking. Business of Apps +2
Socium Media: A performance marketing agency offering full-funnel CTV prospecting, creative testing roadmaps, and audience remarketing.
Direct Avenue: A data-driven direct-response agency specializing in OTT (over-the-top) and CTV performance campaigns.
Clutch Directory: You can browse and filter verified agency reviews, minimum budgets, and case studies on the Clutch US CTV Agencies Directory.
What is your monthly or campaign budget?
